title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Member Terms: Enrollment Fee, Activation Payment Minimum and Activation Window
content:
1. **No enrollment fee.** Enrolling in PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) carries an enrollment fee of 0.00 on every tier.
2. **Activation payment minimum.** The activation payment that starts the meter in prepay mode must be at least the tier's activation payment minimum.
3. **Activation window.** The enrollment must be activated within the tier's activation window, counted in calendar days from the enrollment.

| Tier | Enrollment fee (USD) | Activation payment minimum (USD) | Activation window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 0.00 | 50.00 | 14 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 0.00 | 75.00 | 14 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 0.00 | 100.00 | 14 |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 0.00 | 100.00 | 14 |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 0.00 | 50.00 | 14 |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | 0.00 | 150.00 | 14 |

Illustration (hypothetical): on PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 an activation payment of 100.00 meets the minimum and one of 99.99 does not; on PrePay Power Outbuilding the minimum is 50.00.
